# fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_policy (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_policy" "example" {
  vpc_id      = "your_vpc_id"
  region_name = "your_region_name"
  role_name   = "read-only"
}

output "iam_role_policy" {
  value = data.fptcloud_object_storage_iam_role_policy.example.policy
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region_name` (String) The region name that's are the same with the region name in the S3 service. Currently, we have: HCM-01, HCM-02, HN-01, HN-02
- `role_name` (String) Name of the IAM role whose inline policy to read
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC ID

### Read-Only

- `has_policy` (Boolean) Whether an inline policy is attached
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `policy` (String) The attached inline policy document in JSON format, empty when the role has none
- `policy_name` (String) The name the platform stores the inline policy under
- `template` (String) A starter policy document built around a bucket this account owns. Useful as a beginning for a policy, and it is guaranteed to pass the API's account-scope check
